issues.title: DUPLO sim-to-real実験記録：校正片の接続・実測と通常高さ2×2への移植結果
DUPLO互換ボールレール：実測寸法・断面推定・接続検証

rail.functional_fit: slightly loose; attaches and detaches easily

decisions.global_scale: No global scaling. Printed length difference does not establish XY-axis/pitch compensation.
decisions.port_grid: Keep 16 mm pitch, 4x4 envelope, 19.2 mm drop and end rail profile.
decisions.receiver: Retain tube OD13.30/ID9.40 and wall3.16. Approximate diameters do not justify adding 0.29 mm or 2.00 mm.
decisions.fit_status: Physical retention unresolved. New irregular receiver stiffness must be tested separately.
decisions.floor_removal: Remove unused inner/outer corner floors and tube portions; do not add curved receiver walls that obstruct the 16 lower studs.

validation.reference: Synthetic nominal DUPLO 4x4, 16 hollow studs OD9.40,height4.50
